This [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual, a wealthy [[mineral baron]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Panatha]], was the '''father''' of the [[Epicanthix]] named [[Yun]]. He pampered his son, and as a result, Yun lacked patience needed in the family business. To develop such quality in his son, the baron decided to send him to [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]], to learn from the order of monks known as the [[Followers of Palawa]]. However, after spending only a year with them, Yun returned home, because the monks refused to teach him the ancient martial art [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]]. The baron then decided that his son should get closer with the baron's fiancee, the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophetess of the Dark Side]] [[Sariss]]. This proved to be his ultimate undoing, as Yun, manipulated by Sariss, killed his own father and pledged the family assets to Sariss's master [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]].

==Biography==
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Panatha]] had a business affiliated with [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]]. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he became a wealthy mineral baron. He and an [[Yun's mother|unidentified female]] had a [[Yun's sister|daughter]] and a son named [[Yun]] of the [[Epicanthix]] species. The baron sheltered Yun from worry the entire life, resulting in Yun becoming very pampered and impatient. Since such behavior was bad for the family business, the baron decided to send his son to the planet [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]], to learn from the ancient monk order called the [[Followers of Palawa]].

Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the baron met [[Sariss]], the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophetess of the Dark Side]]. Soon, Sariss became baron's fiancée. However, not long after that, Yun returned from Bunduki, angry at the Palawa monks for not letting him learn the ancient martial art of [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]]. The baron was disappointed, but immediately came out with another idea. He decided that it would be good for Yun if he learned the secrets of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] from Sariss. As the time passed, Yun fell in love with Sariss. She responded to the boy's feelings, but told him that they could not be together because of her vow to the baron. Manipulated by Sariss, Yun killed his father.

Yun later abandoned or killed his mother and sister and pledged all family assets to Sariss master, the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]. Circa a year later, he had a dream of him cutting his father's head with a steel sword.

==Behind the scenes==
This character first appeared in the brief dream sequence in the ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'' novella. His backstory was expanded in ''[[The Dark Forces Saga]]'', a series of RPG scenarios released on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website.
